mapper.select: /** [sql-mfrPartsInput.xml] MfrPartsInputMapper.getPartsInputRequestInfo **/ SELECT ST01.ST01_COMPANY ,ST01.ST01_FACTORY ,ST01.ST01_GBN ,ST01.ST01_LOT ,ST01.ST01_CODE ,ST01.ST01_STOK ,ST01.ST01_DISTRICT ,ST01.ST01_FIELD ,ST01.ST01_UNT ,ST01.ST01_QTY ,ST01.ST01_LOT_SEQ ,CM08.CM08_DGBN ,CM08.CM08_NAME ,CM08.CM08_GBN ,CM08.CM08_CUS ,CM08.CM08_MOQ ,ST03.ST03_LOT ,#{st01Qrcode} as ST01_QRCODE FROM TB_ST_01 ST01 LEFT JOIN TB_CM_08 CM08 ON ST01.ST01_COMPANY = CM08.CM08_COMPANY AND ST01.ST01_FACTORY = CM08.CM08_FACTORY AND ST01.ST01_CODE = CM08.CM08_CODE LEFT JOIN TB_ST_03 ST03 ON ST01.ST01_COMPANY = ST03.ST03_COMPANY AND ST01.ST01_FACTORY = ST03.ST03_FACTORY AND ST01.ST01_LOT = ST03.ST03_LOT AND ST01.ST01_LOT_SEQ = ST03.ST03_LOT_SEQ AND ST03.ST03_GBN = 'MT' WHERE ST01.ST01_COMPANY = #{company} AND ST01.ST01_FACTORY = #{factory} AND ST01.ST01_LOT = #{st01Lot} AND ST01.ST01_LOT_SEQ = #{st01LotSeq} AND ST01.ST01_CODE = #{st01Code}
mapper.insert: /** [sql-mfrPartsInput.xml] MfrPartsInputMapper.updateOfSmdOutStock **/ INSERT INTO TB_ST_03 ( ST03_COMPANY ,ST03_FACTORY ,ST03_NO ,ST03_DAT ,ST03_SEQ ,ST03_CODE ,ST03_LOT ,ST03_GBN ,ST03_PCC ,ST03_NAPNO ,ST03_UNT ,ST03_QTY ,ST03_RMK ,ST03_STOK ,ST03_INDTE ,ST03_EMPNO ,ST03_DGBN ,ST03_QR ,ST03_OUTPUT_NO ,ST03_RENO ,ST03_RTNO ,ST03_OUTPUT_DTL_NO ,ST03_DIST ,ST03_SBNO ,ST03_CUS ,ST03_LOT_SEQ ,ST03_LINE ,ST03_MOQ ,ST03_MST_NO ) VALUES ( #{company} ,#{factory} ,(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') || (SELECT LPAD(NVL(MAX(ST03.ST03_SEQ),0)+1,5,0) FROM TB_ST_03 ST03 WHERE TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') = SUBSTR(ST03.ST03_NO,0,8))) ,TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') ,(SELECT NVL(MAX(ST03.ST03_SEQ),0)+1 FROM TB_ST_03 ST03 WHERE TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') = SUBSTR(ST03.ST03_NO,0,8)) ,#{st01Code} ,#{st01Lot} ,'MT' ,#{mf02Pcc} ,'' ,#{st01Unt} ,#{st01Qty} ,'' ,#{st01Stok} ,SYSDATE ,#{empno} ,'' ,#{st01Qrcode} ,'' ,'' ,'' ,'' ,#{st01District} ,'' ,#{cm08Cus} ,#{st01LotSeq} ,'' ,#{cm08Moq} ,#{mf02Pcc} )
mapper.select: SELECT CM08.*, (CM08.CM08_NAME || '[' || CM08.CM08_CODE || ']') AS MF_DISP FROM TB_CM_08 CM08 WHERE CM08.CM08_MF = 'Y'
